name: TILEZ
author: Sean McCormick & Claude
description: A quiet white SMACKTALK portfolio inspired by editorial design studios. Longform posts flow through a native-aspect three-column wall powered by SnapSmack's shared columns engine.

header_logo.label: Custom Logo
header_logo.help: Upload a logo image to replace the site title text. Transparent PNG recommended.

show_tagline.label: Show Tagline
show_tagline.help: Hide the site tagline under the logo/title (useful when your logo already includes it). The tagline still appears in RSS and social/SEO meta.

tilez_info_page_slug.label: Info Page Slug
tilez_info_page_slug.help: The static page opened by the round information icon, for example about or the-artist.

tilez_theme_look.label: Theme Look (Preset)
tilez_theme_look.help: Choose a base look, then customize any individual colour below.

dark_teal.label: Dark Teal Studio (Light Grey Text & Borders, White Links)

accent_color.label: Accent Colour
accent_color.help: Used for links, buttons, hover states, and interactive elements.

outline.label: Outline (Transparent ring, coloured glyph)
outline.css: { background: transparent; border-color: var(--tilez-icon-border); color: var(--tilez-icon-color); }

solid.label: Solid (Filled circle, contrasting glyph)
solid.css: { background: var(--tilez-icon-color); border-color: var(--tilez-icon-color); color: var(--tilez-icon-contrast); }

show_post_titles.label: Always Show Post Titles in Archive

archive_columns.label: Image Archive Columns
archive_columns.help: Number of smaller native-aspect columns in the Images archive.

archive_gap.label: Image Archive Gap
archive_gap.help: Space between photographs in the Images archive.

caption_color.label: Caption Colour
caption_color.help: The colour of the caption under a photograph. Left as it is, the skin's own shade is used.

caption_size.label: Caption Size (px)
caption_size.help: How large the caption text is.

caption_style.label: Caption Style
caption_style.help: Whether captions are italic, as TILEZ has always set them, or upright.

caption_gap.label: Space Above Caption (px)
caption_gap.help: The gap between a photograph and its caption.

caption_align.label: Caption Alignment
caption_align.help: Captions follow the post's own alignment unless you choose otherwise.
